SISTERS RUN CLUB TORONTO | SEASON 01 RUN 02 | 5K FOR COLOMBIA 🏃🏻‍♀️🇨🇴 🤍

Join us on August 30 for a 5K run/walk for Colombia, a special fundraiser bringing women together through movement while supporting communities affected by the earthquake. 

📍 Downsview Park (Orchard Pavilion)
🗓️ Sunday, August 30
⏰ Meet at 3:00 PM

FREE TO JOIN • PAY WHAT YOU CAN
100% of donations will support earthquake relief efforts in Colombia 🇨🇴🤍

Enjoy some fast chews by @saltstick to keep us energized before the run ❤️💥

After the run, we’ll head to @goodbehaviour.to to relax, connect, and enjoy some delicious food together. When you join us, you’ll also receive 20% off ice cream or smash burgers!🍦🍔 

Whether you run or walk, this is a space for everyone. All ages, backgrounds, and fitness levels are welcome. Come move at your own pace, meet your community, and help us give back 🤍

See you there, sisters! 🏃🏻‍♀️

Join us next Sunday at @padeljunctionca with @saisociety_ for Padel & Perspective 🎾🏓

Enjoy great company, fun padel games, a guided conversation on Perspective & how it’s shaped and some yummy açaì 🥣

Join The Sisters Corner for our Pilates & Wellness Social, an afternoon created for Muslim women to move, reset, connect, and pour a little time back into themselves. 🧘🏻‍♀️🌷

As we head into a new academic year and a fresh season of routines, we wanted to create a space to slow down, take care of ourselves, and be surrounded by a community of sisters. 🤍

Your ticket includes:

🩷 A professionally led Pilates class

🧘🏻‍♀️ Your own Pilates mat to use and take home

🎀 Curated gift bag

🥣 Complimentary açaí bowl

📸 Photo booth to capture the day

🛍️ Local vendors to shop from throughout the event

🌸 A beautiful wellness-inspired setup

🤍 Time to meet and connect with Muslim women from across the GTA

Whether you’re coming with friends or showing up on your own, you’re more than welcome. Come spend the afternoon moving, shopping, taking cute pictures, meeting new sisters, and enjoying some much-needed time for yourself. 💗
